name: vectordrawable-viewer
description: VS Code extension that lets you visualize VectorDrawable XML files. Ideal for quickly iterating edits of simple VectorDrawable assets.

vectordrawableViewer.defaultFillColor.description: Default fill color when android:fillColor is missing.

vectordrawableViewer.defaultFillAlpha.description: Default fill alpha when android:fillAlpha is missing.

vectordrawableViewer.defaultStrokeColor.description: Default stroke color when android:strokeColor is missing.

vectordrawableViewer.defaultStrokeWidth.description: Default stroke width when android:strokeWidth is missing.

vectordrawableViewer.defaultStrokeAlpha.description: Default stroke alpha when android:strokeAlpha is missing.

vectordrawableViewer.defaultTrimStart.description: Default trim start when android:trimStart is missing.

vectordrawableViewer.defaultTrimEnd.description: Default trim end when android:trimEnd is missing.

vectordrawableViewer.defaultTrimOffset.description: Default trim offset when android:trimOffset is missing.

vectordrawableViewer.defaultFillType.description: Default fill type when android:fillType is missing.
